analogy.source: Two dye injections in adjacent sealed microfluidic channels.
analogy.invariant: The partition of accessible endpoints under a change in visual appearance.
analogy.counterexample: Dye crossing beneath another channel at a different depth can overlap in a photograph without sharing fluid.
analogy.status: Analogy and method are conjectures. Drawn candidate fixtures are simulations. Counts and times are measurements. Connected components prove reachability in the given mask only.
